stemMd: Which system is most consistent with both passages?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Require judges to rank musical sophistication.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Allow only performers already known to officials.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Give all prime slots to the fastest online applicants indefinitely.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Use content-neutral safety rules and rotate access to desirable slots through multiple application channels.

explanationMd: The system separates legitimate shared-use regulation from artistic selection and also addresses practical allocation barriers. It satisfies the central concern of each passage without treating either as exhaustive.

distractorRationale.c: That reproduces the second author's concern.
distractorRationale.e: The first permits rules addressing actual conflicts.
distractorRationale.b: That narrows access without a relevant safety basis.
distractorRationale.a: That reinstates the first author's objection.
